source_review_findings: Renderer is byte-exact at the required SHA256. Removing only its two finite appended blocks and restoring the array capacity recovers the published parent renderer exactly.
Every other src file, including original indexed sprite functions, enemy state/call sites, title menu additions, gameplay hooks, input and timing, equals published b2a6e4a.

Six-member preflight checks fixed dimensions/header/EOF and full RGBA stamps before any replacement. No 4x or partial-family substitute; malformed and allocation failures remain confined to the selected-pack startup cache for this family.

Exact bank/base/size/part/layout and direct x/y bounds precede arithmetic/loading. Original linear RLE row wrapping remains classic outside x 0…308, and ordinary partial vertical clips remain supported inside y -13…199.

Original engine filters, indexed writes and caller-owned entity_end remain unchanged. Fresh pixel and temporal tests establish exact authored alpha coverage, all 64 subpixels, ownership, classic overdraw and incoming shadow behavior within the standalone-unit scope.

Historical test portability is bounded by exact published renderer/family identity pins, not an arbitrary branch tip. Entry recorder projects away only the SHA-pinned type3 append and verifies exact predecessor restoration; the small route is separately tested on actual current source.
Regenerated coexistence projection calls the strict frozen source validator before removing six entries and compares the complete remaining serialized manifest to the published parent pin.
